고양이.x: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

받다.m: to receive, to get; to answer (a phone)
받다.x: I got flowers for my birthday.
받다.t: 전화를 받다 = to answer the phone. Pronounced [받따].

환승.ex: 삼십 분 안에 환승을 하면 요금이 무료예요.
환승.x: If you transfer within thirty minutes, it's free.
환승.t: In speech, 갈아타다 is more common; 환승 is what you hear in announcements and see on signs.

금방.m: soon, in a moment; quickly; just now
금방.x: I'll be there soon, please wait just a little.
금방.e: Literally 'now-just'; flip the syllables and you get 방금 'just now'.

추석.x: On Chuseok, I go to my hometown and make songpyeon.
추석.e: Literally 'autumn evening' — the full moon of the eighth lunar month.

알아듣다.forms: 알아들어요 · 알아들었어요 · 알아들을 거예요 · 알아들으세요 (ㄷ irregular)
알아듣다.m: to understand (what one hears), to catch
알아듣다.ex: 선생님이 너무 빨리 말해서 잘 못 알아들었어요.
알아듣다.x: The teacher spoke too fast, so I couldn't really follow.
알아듣다.t: Handy phrase: 잘 못 알아들었어요. 다시 말해 주세요. — 'I didn't catch that; please say it again.'

예방.ex: 감기 예방을 위해 손을 자주 씻으세요.
예방.x: Wash your hands often to prevent colds.

예방.ex: 새로 부임한 대사가 외교부 장관을 예방했습니다.
예방.x: The newly appointed ambassador paid a courtesy call on the foreign minister.
예방.t: Don't confuse with the far more common homonym 예방 (豫防) 'prevention', as in 예방 접종.

기획하다.m: to plan, to organize (a project or event)
기획하다.t: 기획 is used for projects, events and products at work; for personal plans, use 계획.

안정되다.m: to become stable, to settle down, to stabilize
안정되다.x: Prices have stabilized a little lately.

완성하다.x: I finally finished my graduation project.
완성하다.t: 완성하다 is for finishing a product or work; for finishing a task, 끝내다 is more natural.

구성원.m: member (of a group, family or society)
구성원.ex: 가족 구성원 모두가 집안일을 나누어서 해요.
구성원.x: Every member of the family shares the housework.
구성원.e: -원 = member or staff: 구성원, 회사원, 직원.

근력.ex: 나이가 들수록 근력 운동을 꾸준히 해야 해요.
근력.x: The older you get, the more you need to do strength training regularly.
근력.e: Literally 'muscle power'. -력 = power, ability: 체력, 능력.
근력.t: Pronounced [글력] — ㄴ becomes ㄹ before ㄹ.

원작.ex: 이 드라마는 인기 웹툰을 원작으로 만들었어요.
원작.x: This drama was made based on a popular webtoon.
원작.t: Useful pattern: A를 원작으로 하다 'to be based on A'.

잇따라.forms: 잇따라 + verb: 잇따라 발생하다, 잇따라 터지다
잇따라.x: This summer, typhoons came one after another.
잇따라.e: From 잇따르다 'to follow in a row' (잇다 'to join' + 따르다 'to follow').
잇따라.t: Pronounced [읻따라]; very common in news about accidents, complaints, or events.

힘겹다.ex: 할머니는 무거운 짐을 들고 힘겹게 계단을 올라가셨어요.
힘겹다.x: Grandma struggled up the stairs carrying a heavy bag.
힘겹다.e: Built from 힘 'strength' + 겹다 'too much to handle': more than your strength can bear.
힘겹다.t: Often as an adverb: 힘겹게 'with great effort', 힘겹게 버티다 'to barely hang on'.

마음을 놓다.forms: 마음을 놓아요(놔요) · 마음을 놓았어요 · 마음 놓고 (without worry)
마음을 놓다.m: to relax, to stop worrying, to feel at ease
마음을 놓다.ex: 아이가 무사히 도착했다는 전화를 받고 마음을 놓았어요.
마음을 놓다.x: I got a call that my child had arrived safely, and I could finally relax.
마음을 놓다.e: Literally 'to put down one's heart,' like setting down a heavy load.

마음이 놓이다.m: to feel relieved, to be at ease
마음이 놓이다.ex: 의사 선생님 말씀을 듣고 나니 마음이 놓였어요.
마음이 놓이다.x: After hearing what the doctor said, I felt relieved.
마음이 놓이다.e: 놓이다 is the passive of 놓다 'to put down.'
마음이 놓이다.t: 마음을 놓다 is something you do; 마음이 놓이다 is a feeling that happens to you.

연등.ex: 부처님 오신 날에 절에 가서 연등을 달았어요.
연등.x: On Buddha's Birthday, I went to a temple and hung a lantern.
연등.e: Literally 'burning lamp'. The 연 is 'burn', not 연꽃 'lotus', even though many lanterns are lotus-shaped.
연등.t: Every spring Seoul holds 연등회, a lantern festival and parade, ahead of Buddha's Birthday.

심정.ex: 가족을 잃은 사람들의 심정은 말로 다 할 수 없어요.
심정.x: Words can't express how people who lost their families feel.
심정.t: Often in 그 심정 이해해요 'I understand how you feel'.

실향민.m: displaced people who lost their hometown (especially from North Korea)
실향민.x: Every holiday, displaced people miss their hometowns in the North.

품격.x: This hotel's service is in a class of its own.

마지못해.x: He reluctantly apologized in front of everyone.
마지못해.e: From 마지못하다, probably 말지 못하다 'cannot refuse'.
마지못해.t: Pronounced [마지모태]: ㅅ before ㅎ turns into an aspirated ㅌ sound.

기백.ex: 젊은 배우들의 기백이 넘치는 멋진 무대였어요.
기백.x: It was a great performance overflowing with the young actors' vigor.

조롱.ex: 그는 사람들의 조롱에도 꿈을 포기하지 않았어요.
조롱.x: Even with people's ridicule, he didn't give up his dream.
조롱.t: 조롱거리가 되다 means 'to become a laughingstock'; stronger than playful 놀림.

태업.m: work slowdown, go-slow (as a labor protest)
태업.x: The union started a work slowdown instead of a strike.
태업.t: Unlike 파업 (strike), in a 태업 workers still show up but work slowly on purpose.

유형문화재.ex: 이 절의 오래된 종은 유형문화재로 지정되었어요.
유형문화재.x: This temple's old bell has been designated a tangible cultural property.
유형문화재.e: Literally 'cultural asset with form', such as buildings and objects.

잠식하다.m: to encroach on, to eat into, to erode gradually
잠식하다.ex: 외국 기업들이 국내 시장을 잠식하고 있습니다.
잠식하다.x: Foreign companies are eating into the domestic market.
잠식하다.e: Literally 'silkworm eating' — nibbling away bit by bit like a silkworm on a leaf.

소급되다.m: to be retroactive, to apply retroactively
소급되다.ex: 이번 법 개정은 작년 1월로 소급되어 적용됩니다.
소급되다.x: This legal amendment applies retroactively to last January.
소급되다.e: Literally 'go back and reach' an earlier point in time.
소급되다.t: Pronounced [소급뙤다]. Usually in 소급 적용 (retroactive application).

포용하다.m: to embrace, to accept (with tolerance), to be inclusive toward
포용하다.ex: 우리 사회는 다양한 문화를 포용해야 합니다.
포용하다.x: Our society should embrace diverse cultures.
포용하다.e: Literally 'wrap and contain' — making room for differences.

혼동하다.m: to confuse, to mix up (one thing with another)
혼동하다.ex: 많은 학생들이 두 단어의 뜻을 혼동합니다.
혼동하다.x: Many students confuse the meanings of the two words.
혼동하다.e: Literally 'mix as the same' — mistaking one thing for another.
혼동하다.t: Pattern: A를 B와 혼동하다; don't mix it up with 혼란 'chaos, disorder'.

도식화.ex: 현실을 지나치게 도식화하면 중요한 부분을 놓칠 수 있습니다.
도식화.x: If you oversimplify reality too much, you can miss important parts.

전인미답.m: untrodden, never achieved by anyone before
전인미답.x: The athlete set a record no one had ever reached before.
전인미답.e: Literally 'ground no earlier person has stepped on.'
전인미답.t: Typically 전인미답의 + noun: 전인미답의 경지, 전인미답의 기록.
